text:
QUOTE: The deny list is the hard gate. It is checked last, in `execute`, so it applies even to calls that `auto_approve` or the allow list already approved.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the deny list in `ServerManager::execute` is the only check that can't be bypassed. It also describes an approval gate that can reject a call before execution (e.g. "Permission denied" when there is no callback, no allow match and auto_approve is off). So it does not conclude that deny is the only list that blocks execution.
